Mixing the two orientations with p=(1-lambda/sqrt(1-kappa^2))/2 gives the implemented +i*lambda[A,B]/2. The weights are valid in the disk, giving Hermitian trace1 PSD effects and probabilities in[0,1] in exact arithmetic.
